Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12457, whose subject line describes continuing the President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness and increasing its membership. Paragraph (a) rewrites the second sentence of section 1(a) of Executive Order 12428 so that the Commission is composed of no more than thirty-five members appointed or designated by the President. Whether the end of the Commission’s life extinguished this membership ceiling is not shown by a held source, so the first held end of this clause is the revocation. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12428 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event. No earlier express end was found.

Terminated by its own terms. Paragraph (b) rewrites section 4(b) of Executive Order 12428 to provide that the Commission terminates on December 31, 1984, unless sooner extended. The stated day is recorded inclusively, so the first end is dated 1984-12-31; on the exclusive reading the end falls on 1984-12-30, disclosed for the reviewer (owner ruling 2026-10-21, until-dates). No extension is held: a number search of the held Federal Register order texts (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts) for the parent order 12428 found citations only in Executive Orders 12440, 12457 and 12534. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked this order by number (the table lists 12457, whose subject line describes continuing the President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness and increasing its membership); it is a later event because the clause had already ended. No earlier end was found. Executive Order 12534 of September 30, 1985 (held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12534.txt; not among this packet’s citable evidence) revokes the parent order 12428 but does not name this order; under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (unnamed instruments) it is a disclosed candidate earlier end for the reviewer and not an end, and it is not recorded as a later event.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12457 (49 FR 865, Federal Register of January 6, 1984; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness and signed January 3, 1984. It increases the membership and extends the life of the President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness. Inventory: the lead-in and paragraphs (a) and (b), each recorded as one clause and confirmed against the full held text. Ending: Paragraph (b) ended on its own sunset (1984-12-31, inclusive); the lead-in and paragraph (a) end on EO 12553 (1986-02-25), so the whole-order end is the later date. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12457, whose subject line describes continuing the President’s Commission on Industrial Competitiveness and increasing its membership.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found no held text citing this order by number other than its own printings. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
